rule: Method: `Type#member`. Nested types are dotted: `Outer.Inner#m`. | Constructor / initializer call: `Type#<init>`. | Typed receivers (decision A, all statically typed languages and typed PHP/Groovy declarations): a receiver whose type is given by a declaration — local, parameter, field/property (including `$var->prop` / `obj.field` chains whose property has a declared type), catch parameter, for-loop variable, pattern binding — or by `= new T(...)` gives `T#m` (high if defined in the scan, else medium).
notes: Block namespace App.Core, nested class Outer.Inner → App.Core.Outer.Inner#m. Inside Inner, bare Seed() resolves lexically to the enclosing type Outer's static member (C2: the ID names the type that defines it). `var inner = new Inner()` types inner by `= new T(...)` (decision A). Outer.Inner.Twice(2) is a static call on the nested type. Every instantiated scanned class declares its constructor explicitly, so <init> is high.
